## Checklist

- [ ] `source` is filled in: `Family recipe` / `Our own` for something of ours,
      or a real attribution naming the title, author, and where it was published.
- [ ] If adapted from somewhere else, the method is **written in my own words** —
      nothing is pasted from a book or a website.
- [ ] No other people's names, in the title, the `source`, or a note. Anything
      that should not be published went to `private/` instead.
- [ ] No email addresses, phone numbers, street addresses, coordinates, or links
      into private storage.
- [ ] `make check` passes, and the hooks ran (no `--no-verify`).
